svg.aria-label: TLS 1.3 handshake: the client sends supported ciphers and a key share; the server answers with its key share, certificate and a signature; the client checks the certificate against trusted authorities; both derive the same session keys and switch to fast symmetric encryption.
svg.title: TLS 1.3 handshake: the client sends supported ciphers and a key share; the server answers with its key share, certificate and a signature; the client checks the certificate against trusted authorities; both derive the same session keys and switch to fast symmetric encryption.
svg.text: browser checks: certificate signed by a trusted CA? name matches? not expired?
both sides derive the same secret keys (ECDHE) — never sent over the wire
